_comment: A pinned, unmodified copy of Microsoft's Graph Python SDK snippets that Learn's national cloud page renders. Never edit these files: update the snapshot by copying a newer upstream commit and regenerating this manifest in a reviewed pull request. scripts/tests/test_third_party_snapshots.py fails when a file stops matching its hash.
name: Microsoft Graph Python SDK snippets (national clouds and client creation)
license: MIT (LICENSE, copied from the repository root)
not_copied: src/main.py, src/graph.py and src/config.cfg (an interactive device code sign-in app; the chapter never signs in)
src/snippets/create_requests.py, src/snippets/custom_clients.py and src/snippets/middleware/ (request and middleware snippets the chapter doesn't use)
requirements.txt, pylintrc, .github/, .vscode/ and the repository's other housekeeping files
